Sentence (English): This is the third Bosch dishwasher we have owned.
Comments (English): [ Newer doesn't always mean better ] || ---------------- || This is the third Bosch dishwasher we have owned. We were satisfied with the previous two, but the third is a mixed bag of good and bad. We opted for the model with the controls on the top of the door because that was the only version with the bottom rack we liked. We would have preferred the version with front controls, but that model was only available with the smaller silverware basket. (We like the long basket that sits on the right side of the rack.) While the top controls give a sleek, clean look to the dishwasher, that was not important to us. Because of the placement, we often accidentally touch one or more of the controls. That never happened with the controls on the front. The top controls do not have a delay feature. To set a delay, you need to download an app on your phone, pair the app with the dishwasher, and basically make the dishwasher a smart appliance. The simplicity of the previous models we owned was ideal. Our lives are so intruded by the internet, I don't want another thing that requires an app just to set a 4-hour delay. With that rant aside, we do appreciate the cleaning ability of the dishwasher. We also like the new shallow rack at the top that allows us to wash small custard cups, serving utensils that don't fit in the silverware basket, and other non-standard items. The "middle" rack still holds mainly drinkware and food storage containers, but it can be adjusted so that the left and right sides are at different levels. The flexibility to load taller items using this feature is nice, but the rack feels wobbly as you move it back and forth. Fortunately, it hasn't come loose yet. Noise-wise, the door seems less insulated, so the noise levels are slightly higher, but not enough to be disturbing. In summary, if you want simplicity, you may be disappointed with the newer features of this dishwasher, but with time you will probably adjust your expectations and learn to appreciate that this dishwasher still cleans like a Bosch.

Sentence (English): I've had this for about a month now.

Each rack is sturdy and pulls out easily and goes back in easy. It cleans great, 3rd rack utensils may occasionally have some food still on as if it was not getting fully sprayed off from direct water contact. Might be the way the utensils were stacked but just something to be aware of. The one thing I wish was different was with the delay feature. If you set the wash delay and open it up to add additional dishes you have to hit the start/resume again for the timer to continue. Would want it so you could just open, add dishes, and close without having to hit the start resume again. Extremely happy so far.

Sentence (English): DO NOT buy a Bosch dishwasher from Costco!

This 3rd party logistics company does not appear to know or care about the important aspects of installing a Bosch dishwasher properly. So, Costco farms out the install to a 3rd party Logistics company and the 3rd party Logistics company farms the install out to a subcontractor in your city whom they may or may not know is properly trained. In my opinion, this is a recipe for disaster/bad installation.

Sentence (English): As always, if buying through Costco your purchase is receiving added value with the services offered.
Comments (English): [ A Satisfied Costco Customer ] || ---------------- || As always, if buying through Costco your purchase is receiving added value with the services offered. In most cases free installation and removal- recycling of used appliances. This alone is a substantial benefit and saving and is seldom offered at other retailers, so take that into account when determining overall savings. My installation was flawless, efficient and professional. No install is perfect but in the overall experience and expectations this went without a hitch. If you prepare for the delivery in advance then the process goes smoothly. As for the appliance ( Bosch 300 series) it has performed as expected. It is a Dishwasher so it is difficult to go Gaga over an appliance. The quality is of a higher grade in terms of materials used to make it over other brands that feel like cheap replacements and they are. I personally shopped other retailers looking at different display models and brand names and the quality difference is very obvious. You need to compare to match your expectations. Overall this series is good value without some of the additional options the other series offers which we didn't need. It is quiet. A few decibels in sound is unlikely detectable without sound equipment and paying for that extra quiet is not necessary unless you're trying to live life in a sound proof environment. Keep your old silverware basket from your other washer you are replacing. You may not care for the third utensil rack and can simply continue to place your utensils into the older basket as a quick and efficient means to wash these items. I personally don't want to take the time laying individual spoons and forks etc into the third rack. Some people will like it but I'm old school. I'm satisfied with this washer brand and it was highly rated in consumer reports for quality, reliability and value. I trust Consumers. Some of the reviews mentioned a plastic smell after washing, similar to a new car smell, it fades with time and use and does not impact the wash quality. Plastics do not dry like glass and dishes do. They will still have a bit of moisture ( water) On them. Not a big deal to me. They are clean shake the few drops off, done. After the wash cycle open ( crack) the dishwasher door for 10 minutes to let out residual moisture and then put them away dry. Simple. Yes I would recommend this product. Skip the lower decibel rating added cost for this 300 series. This was a front control dishwasher. I don't need to pay more for a top control just to hide controls.

Sentence (English): Cleans decent and is very quiet.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Cleans decent and is very quiet. Drying could be better especially at this price point of a dishwasher. Everything loaded into the 3rd rack has to be almost completely clean beforehand or you will be washing them again. First 2 racks clean fine. Love the height adjustments on the racks. I have included a picture to help you visualize the room available for washing. As you can see it will fit normal sizes dinner plates with an oversize slushi machine container and still fit the tumblers on the second rack. It also has a built-in light which i didn't realize how nice that is until i got this dishwasher. Overall its a nice dishwasher, i got it on sale display model for 450 and would definitely buy again at that price point. However if you're looking to spend 1000+ which is what it normally costs i would look to a newer model that pops the door open to help drying, and perhaps cleans a bit better instead of this one.

Sentence (English): Our old builder grade GE dishwasher died and we took our time researching a replacement.
Comments (English): [ Solid construction, SUPER quiet. So much room. ] || ---------------- || Our old builder grade GE dishwasher died and we took our time researching a replacement. I read reviews, price shopped and decided 'bang for buck, this was our best choice. We don't care about the smart features and haven't even activated that. Someone very efficient planned the layout of the racks and tines. This is so well designed it takes us longer to fill it. Probably perfect for a larger family.The extra / 3rd drawer comes in handy. We're still experimenting with whether to use the silverware caddy or the 3rd drawer. It's so quiet, if not for the light that shines on the floor indicating it's on, we'd never know. One thing to know is that it requires a plug to power it. Our installer arrived with a GFI outlet and installed that for $120 extra. And the other thing to know buying from Costco, the unit arrives the day before and must be delivered to the same level as where it will be installed. Fortunately, I was able to find a spot for it to stay until the installer came.

Sentence (English): I have a 12-person dishwasher, and I'm so pleased with the Frosh Green Lemon Tablets that I'm leaving a review.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher perfect for a three-person household! ] || ---------------- || I have a 12-person dishwasher, and I'm so pleased with the Frosh Green Lemon Tablets that I'm leaving a review. I usually do a lot of dishes, so I almost always fill both the top and bottom compartments. If the cleaning power isn't enough, water stains and grease will remain. This product, however, maintains its consistent cleaning power even when both compartments are full, so I trust it. I especially notice a difference on days when I've eaten greasy food. The dishes can get slippery the next day after grilling pork belly or cooking oily dishes like pancakes or stir-fries. This tablet effectively removes grease. I don't need to pre-wash the dishes; just shake off the basic food scraps and they come out clean. I'm also very satisfied with the glassware, which is clear and clean without leaving a cloudy residue. The mini tablets are easy to insert into the slot, and they come in a water-soluble film, so they're convenient and easy to use. They don't get the detergent directly on your hands, which is both hygienic and convenient. The scent is refreshingly lemony, but not overpowering. It's subtle and pleasant enough to leave a pleasant after-drying feeling. I also like that it doesn't leave a lingering scent on the dishes. Since we wash our dishes at least once a day, detergent selection is crucial. This product strikes a perfect balance between cleaning power and stability. It washes dishes, pots, frying pans, and even glassware cleanly without streaks. I was especially pleased with how well it removed grease stains from plastic lunch boxes. There's no foam or detergent residue, and water stains don't remain after drying. One tablet is enough for two full compartments of a 12-person dishwasher, making it economical. If the cleaning power is weak, you might wonder if you should use two tablets, but this one eliminates that need. Sentence (English): We got the Bosch 500 dishwasher in July 2025.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 500 ] || ---------------- || We got the Bosch 500 dishwasher in July 2025. We are exceptionally happy with it for the most part. Adding the dishwasher app was hard as it says to scan a QR code sticker on side of dishwasher that didn't exist. I also do not love the fact that there is no actual drying element in the dishwasher. I have to time my washings to allow ample time for dishes to air dry (even with dishwasher fluid added) otherwise, I spend my time hand drying. That is one of the biggest drawbacks. Two other issues I don't love is how flimsy the front dishwasher door is. Our old dishwasher (a KitchenAid) was very solid and this door feels super flimsy and bends/twists. The quality of our dishwasher compared to 6 other family members with older Bosch dishwashers is a huge difference. You can tell the quality of materials have gone down signficantly. If I were to buy over again, I would still buy this dishwasher as I love the setup inside and how exceptionally quiet it is. Our old dishwasher was loud. Very loud. This one is so quiet, that I don't even know its on except for the red light shining on the floor while it's running.

Sentence (English): When remodeling my kitchen, I chose this dishwasher for both design and performance, and I'm very satisfied with the result.
Comments (English): When remodeling my kitchen, I chose this dishwasher for both design and performance, and I'm very satisfied with the result. The nature beige color is not overpowering but rather calming, blending seamlessly with any kitchen decor. True to its Objet Collection roots, it feels more like a piece of furniture than an appliance, and the installation has made my kitchen look much cleaner. The dishwasher's cleaning power exceeded my expectations. Thanks to the hot air and steam functions, it washes even greasy frying pans and pots cleanly without pre-washing, and it dries thoroughly, leaving virtually no water stains. It's also remarkably quiet, so I didn't find it bothersome even when running it at night. The spacious interior is large enough to hold a family of four's dishes at once, and the adjustable shelves make it easy to store large dishes and pots. The automatic door-open drying feature is also useful, keeping the interior dry until you remove it, ensuring a hygienic feel. The installer was friendly and the operation was easy, making it a great choice for first-time dishwashers. While it's pricey, considering the savings in daily dishwashing time, I feel it's well worth it.
Comments (Original): 주방 리모델링하면서 디자인과 성능을 모두 고려해 선택했는데 결과적으로 매우 만족스럽습니다. 네이처 베이지 색상이 과하지 않고 차분해서 어떤 주방 인테리어에도 자연스럽게 어울립니다. 오브제컬렉션답게 가전이라기보다 가구 같은 느낌이라 설치 후 주방 분위기가 훨씬 깔끔해졌어요. 세척력도 기대 이상입니다. 열풍과 스팀 기능 덕분에 기름기 많은 프라이팬이나 냄비도 애벌세척 없이 깨끗하게 세척되고, 건조까지 확실하게 되어 물 얼룩이 거의 남지 않습니다. 소음도 상당히 조용한 편이라 밤에 돌려도 크게 거슬리지 않았습니다. 내부 공간이 넉넉해 4인 가족 식기 한 번에 정리할 수 있고, 선반 높이 조절이 가능해 큰 그릇이나 냄비 넣기도 편합니다. 자동문 열림 건조 기능도 유용해서 꺼내기 전까지 내부에 습기가 차지 않아 위생적인 느낌입니다. 설치 기사님도 친절했고 사용법도 어렵지 않아 처음 식기세척기 쓰는 분들에게도 추천할 만합니다. 가격대는 있지만 매일 설거지 시간 줄어드는 걸 생각하면 충분히 값어치를 한다고 느껴집니다.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher in mid-December.
Comments (English): [ Disappointed by the drying ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher in mid-December. I've been using it for two months now, about every other day. In terms of washing efficiency, it's excellent; it's particularly effective. And it does it quietly! However, the zeolite drying system it's equipped with was advertised as very efficient, especially for drying plastics. This isn't the case. The drying isn't any more effective than a standard model (my previous dishwasher was over 10 years old and very basic). I find just as much water on the plastic items as before, even when the Perfect Dry option is activated. From this perspective, I'm very disappointed with my purchase and I really regret not choosing a model with an automatic door (or a combination of both systems). Luckily, I did get a few extra convenience features to lessen the disappointment.
Comments (Original): [ Déçu par le séchage ] || ---------------- || J'ai acheté ce lave-vaisselle mi-décembre. Cela fait donc deux mois que je l'utilise, tous les deux jours en moyenne. En terme de d'efficacité de lavage, il n'y a rien à dire, il est particulièrement performant. Et il fait ça en silence !En revanche, le système de séchage zeolith dont il est équipé était présenté comme très efficace, notamment pour sécher les plastiques. Ce n'est pas le cas. Le séchage n'est pas plus efficace qu'un modèle classique (mon lave-vaisselle précédent avait plus de 10 ans et était très basique). Je retrouve autant d'eau qu'avant sur les pièces en plastique, y compris en activant l'option Perfect Dry. De ce point de vue, je suis très déçu de mon achat et je regrette vraiment de ne pas avoir pris un modèle avec ouverture de la porte automatique (ou une combinaison des deux systèmes).Heureusement que j'ai gagné quelques fonctions de confort supplémentaires pour limiter la déception.

Sentence (English): My aunt settled in with a 14-seat dishwasher in our newly built single-family home.
Comments (English): [ Hiring an aunt for a family with multiple children ] || ---------------- || My aunt settled in with a 14-seat dishwasher in our newly built single-family home. This was our first purchase, and at around 700,000 won, it was a great value. Even without the highly anticipated hot air dryer function, the basic features were sufficient, so we chose this product for its value. The existing dishwasher was originally designed with space in mind when decorating. Due to a communication error with the first installer, the mop holder was cut to fit the bottom. After re-installing, we removed the wooden channel, raised it 6cm above the sink door, and had it re-installed. It was a bit of a hassle, but fortunately, it was resolved amicably. When installing, you should have fully appealed to the customer, including the desired location and interior design. Ultimately, I'm very satisfied with the price and the aesthetic of this new dishwasher. Now, I need to go buy dishwasher detergent.
Comments (Original): [ 다자녀 가정에 이모님 고용체결 ] || ---------------- || 신축 단독주택 가정 내, 14인용 식기세척기 이모님 정착. 처음 구매한 제품이며, 70만원대라는 가성비있게 구매. 아주 기대되고 있는 중임열풍건조기능 없어도, 기본기 충분하다하여, 가성비로 선택. 기존 장은 원래 인테리어시, 식세기장 공간 고려. 1차 방문기사와 커뮤니케이션 오류로 걸레받이를 절단하여, 하단부에 맞춤.재시공원하여, 다시 목찬넬 제거후, 싱크대 문라인으로 6cm 올리고 다시 시공 받음. 서로 껄끄러웠으나, 다행히 원만히 해결됨.처음 설치하실때, 원하는 위치 인테리어구성등 충분히 어필해야됨.결론은, 이 가격에 신제품 식세기 인테리어 감성까지 아주 만족함.이제 식세기 세제사러 가야겠다.

Sentence (English): I hate hate hate this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Plastic interior ruins the entire experience ] || ---------------- || I hate hate hate this dishwasher. I bought it in 11/2023 and yes it still runs, but there is so many annoying things about it. I bought it because it was a higher tier dishwasher and it was silent. I can vouch for how quiet it is, but there's too many plastic components inside that fail.It first started with the left side wheels. They snap onto the bottom shelf and after enough hot washes and stress on the plastic keeping it on, the wheels fall off almost every single time I pull out the bottom shelf. I finally switched it up with the back wheels, but I only think it is a matter of time before those fail. I anticipate no issues with the right side since they attach in a way that gets pushed back on when you pull out the shelf.The next thing to fall off and have to be put back on after every wash now is the top basket sprayer. It's more of a pain to attach than the wheel because you have several attachment points, all of which have failed.I know, I didn't buy the extended warranty, but come on, expecting important plastic parts to last in an appliance that regularly has extreme temperatures is an obvious point of failure. My Sears appliance had none of these issues in the 18 years I owned it. I'm just really let down and annoyed.

Sentence (English): Installation is a bit of a pain, only has 3 legs, just one centered in the back, which makes leveling it extremely sensitive to small adjustments.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher, or computer that doesn't work right? ] || ---------------- || Installation is a bit of a pain, only has 3 legs, just one centered in the back, which makes leveling it extremely sensitive to small adjustments. Having only 3 legs, and an imperfect floor, adjusting one foot changes level both side-to-side and front-to-back, so it takes several attempts to get it just right. The rear leg is easy to adjust, has a mechanism to do so from the front. The front legs however are very difficult to turn, which causes much frustration while you're laying on your side trying to get it level. Once it's all hooked up, it has a very annoying beep for both the buttons and when you close it. Figured there's a setting for that, so checked the manual; the paper manual has a few settings listed, but says to use the app or online manual for the full list of settings (the other half of that page is 75% blank, plenty of space to have the full list of settings printed) I don't want an app for my dishwasher, not everything needs an app. Checked the online manual, and found settings for sound, turned all sounds off, saved the settings per the instructions in the manual, and wouldn't you know it, everything still beeps, just quieter. This is top of the line equipment, why can't the settings be straightforward without requiring the decoding chart only available online, and then the settings don't work the way it says. For $1550, this is unacceptable. I will likely be returning this and getting something different that doesn't beep all the time, I went with the quietest available option, I don't want added beeps for every step of the process. I don't want to download an app to change settings in plain English, I don't want to have to download said app and connect to WiFi in order to disable WiFi (yes, that's the only way to access the WiFi settings, through the app), I don't want to not be able to run the machine's self clean cycle only via the app. Also saw in the manual that all settings must be reset after a power outage. There is simply too much technology put into this, without any benefit.

Sentence (English): I received my LG DF365FMS dishwasher on Thursday.
Comments (English): [ LG DF365FMS: good product, installation needs improvement ] || ---------------- || I received my LG DF365FMS dishwasher on Thursday. The appliance itself seems to be of good quality: the design is sleek, the features are appealing, and, to be confirmed over time, it currently meets my expectations. Therefore, I gave it 4 stars for quality and features, as well as 4 stars for value for money, having benefited from a special offer. However, the installation experience was disappointing. The delivery men were clearly there to deliver, not to install. They didn't understand the procedure at all: difficulty screwing in the hose, forced the dishwasher door open, the base fixing strip wasn't installed, and the moisture-resistant tape was left on the countertop. That same evening, we had to unplug everything to properly reposition the strip ourselves. Yet, the owner's manual clearly states that installation must be carried out by qualified personnel to ensure correct setup. The problem isn't with the delivery drivers themselves, but with the fact that we were promised an installation that, in reality, wasn't carried out by trained professionals. I also noted on the delivery slip that the door was slightly misaligned and required some force to open, but I received no follow-up. Unfortunately, customer service is difficult to reach. For all these reasons, I gave 3 stars for the installation experience, which could have been much better, and I'm still waiting to discuss it with their customer service.
Comments (Original): [ LG DF365FMS : bon produit, installation à revoir ] || ---------------- || J’ai reçu mon lave-vaisselle LG DF365FMS jeudi. L’appareil en lui-même semble de bonne qualité : le design est soigné, les fonctionnalités sont intéressantes et, à confirmer dans le temps, il répond pour l’instant à mes attentes. J’ai donc mis 4 étoiles pour la qualité et les caractéristiques, ainsi que 4 étoiles pour le rapport qualité-prix, ayant bénéficié d’une offre spéciale.En revanche, l’expérience d’installation a été décevante. Les livreurs étaient visiblement là pour livrer, pas pour installer. The electrical connection to the float in the drip tray is too short. In addition, the connection faces away from you. This means you have to plug/unplug this connection blind. Who thought this was a good idea? Either make the wires longer so you plug/unplug the connection with the drip tray fully removed or have the connection face the front so you can see what you are doing. The delicate wires will thank you. There are zero foldable tines on the bottom and middle racks. The old LG dishwasher had an excess of folding tines on both racks. Folding tines makes for more flexibility when washing larger items. The utensil bin on the first rack doesn't have enough spaces for silverware. There is a third rack for larger utensils. Decrease the size of the open areas in the bins and put more spots for silverware. The installation and usage instructions were lacking and could be improved. A parts list should be included in the user manual. We went with the stainless finish on this model because we would have to pay the same price for the next model down in black (which in the color we actually wanted), plus to get black we would've had to wait a month for delivery. More readily available color choices would be nice.

Sentence (English): I'm very disappointed with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Very disappointed ] || ---------------- || I'm very disappointed with this dishwasher. To be honest, it's just as loud, if not louder, than my old one. I expected a new appliance to be significantly quieter – unfortunately, that's not the case here. The installation also seems less well-designed and less optimized than my old dishwasher. Some details don't seem to be very user-friendly. The buttons don't work as well as on my previous dishwasher either. The controls feel less premium and less precise. But what bothers me most is that a comparable new dishwasher like my old one costs only about half of what I paid. My old Hanseatic worked flawlessly for 10 years – and at a much lower price. I'd love to remove the new one and return it. Unfortunately, access is very difficult, so removing and repacking it would be a huge hassle. Overall, I can't recommend this model. You can buy much cheaper dishwashers that work just as well and last just as long.

Sentence (English): I have been very impressed with the great job my new dishwasher does cleaning the dishes.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher with some glitches ] || ---------------- || I have been very impressed with the great job my new dishwasher does cleaning the dishes. Intro videos say you don't have to scrape dishes and it's true - dishes come out clean without scraping. But, I have found the following glitches: 1. It was not an easy machine to figure out the control panel. The control panel is on the top of the door. It has lights and several programming buttons. The buttons light up when the door is open but turn off when the door is closed! Why can't they be lit up when the door is closed? I didn't find this out in the manual, I had to search it online because I thought there was something wrong. 2. One of the important features to me was "delay start". I found out in the product manual that that feature would only be available thru the "Home Connect" app that you have to set up to not only use that feature but other features as well. 3. The Home Connect app info makes it sound like it's easy to use, but I have found it difficult to use. I FINALLY figured it out after much frustration. I tried to call Bosch support and after waiting 10" on hold, I hung up. I found some help with an online video on Youtube that a customer figured out, but not from Bosch. I was so frustrated I seriously thought about returning the dishwasher (which I would have had to do within 48 hours per policy of the box store where I purchased it). I could have purchased a different brand that was less expensive, but spent the extra money to purchase this dishwasher because of reading about Bosch's great ratings and dependabiliy. Fortunately I tried several cycles of dishwashing first, kept plugging along with trying to figure out the app and control panel, and decided I would keep it after all since it does such a great job washing my dishes. I hope Bosch listens to my concerns, because you seem to have a great product, but I also hope other customers won't have to go thru the frustrations I have gone thru.

Sentence (English): This review is for the Bosch Benchmark SHX9PCM5N dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great Unit Damaged by Bosch's Shipping Decisions ] || ---------------- || This review is for the Bosch Benchmark SHX9PCM5N dishwasher. We purchased this as a replacement for our prior eight-year-old Bosch. There was nothing wrong with our prior unit, we just decided to upgrade to the newer version of the one we had at the time we did some kitchen upgrades. We were very satisfied with our first Bosch. Thus, we decided to stick with a good thing. I believe this newer model would have lasted just as long as our first. Upon receiving our SHX9PCM5N, I noticed a black mark on the inside of the door. Upon closer examination it appears all the stainless-steel coating was rubbed off (see picture). Then I noticed the metal part of handle for the lower rack had corresponding marks (see picture). What it looks like is the lower rack was moving during shipment and was contacting the inside of the door. I reached out to Home Depot's customer service, who was fantastic. They promptly had a replacement to us. However, upon arrival of the second unit I had to refuse delivery because it had similar marks (see pictures). Additionally, there was a light film of rust already developing on the lower rack's handle. I have now elected to go with another brand. I don't believe a third unit would produce different results. I suggest that Bosh add some type of protection on the racks' handles before shipment. Otherwise, the company is going to have a large number of returns. Note: This one star review is strictly for damaged caused by improper shipping standards. I cannot rate the dishwasher as we new got past the point of putting it through the test.

Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher with some glitches ] || ---------------- || I have been very impressed with the great job my new dishwasher does cleaning the dishes. Intro videos say you don't have to scrape dishes and it's true - dishes come out clean without scraping. But, I have found the following glitches:. 1. It was not an easy machine to figure out the control panel. The control panel is on the top of the door. It has lights and several programming buttons. The buttons light up when the door is open but turn off when the door is closed! Why can't they be lit up when the door is closed? I didn't find this out in the manual, I had to search it online because I thought there was something wrong. 2. One of the important features to me was "delay start". I found out in the product manual that that feature would only be available thru the "Home Connect" app that you have to set up to not only use that feature but other features as well. 3. I tried to call Bosch support and after waiting 10" on hold, I hung up. I found some help with an online video on Youtube that a customer figured out, but not from Bosch. I was so frustrated I seriously thought about returning the dishwasher (which I would have had to do within 48 hours per policy of the box store where I purchased it). I could have purchased a different brand that was less expensive, but spent the extra money to purchase this dishwasher because of reading about Bosch's great ratings and dependabiliy. Fortunately I tried several cycles of dishwashing first, kept plugging along with trying to figure out the app and control panel, and decided I would keep it after all since it does such a great job washing my dishes. I hope Bosch listens to my concerns, because you seem to have a great product, but I also hope other customers won't have to go thru the frustrations I have gone thru.

Sentence (English): As I was pregnant with my second child, eating out became increasingly difficult, and I naturally started eating home-cooked meals more often.
Comments (English): As I was pregnant with my second child, eating out became increasingly difficult, and I naturally started eating home-cooked meals more often. However, even for simple meals, using the kids' plates, snack plates, and even the adults' dishes quickly piled up, and washing up after every meal was a challenge. So, I took the plunge and decided to get a dishwasher. My husband and I visited several offline stores and compared prices online, and Coupang was the cheapest. I was worried that installing the dishwasher would take longer than buying it in-store and that it wouldn't be properly installed, but we could even choose a specific installation date, which made it easy to schedule. The installer was so friendly and did a great job, which was a real pleasure. I tried it out right away, and as expected, the most satisfying thing about it was its large capacity. After a family meal, there were more dishes than I expected, but it all fit in one place, eliminating the need for multiple dishes. The top shelf is adjustable to three heights, so it can easily accommodate large pots and tall glasses. The dedicated cutlery tray keeps cutlery neatly washed and organized! The more I look at it, the more I realize how cleverly the space is utilized. There are various washing cycles, such as automatic, 1-hour, strong, and quiet, so you can choose the right one for you. On oily days, I use the strong cycle, and on normal days, I use the automatic cycle, which automatically adjusts to the level of dirt, which is convenient. And the cleaning power is amazing! It feels cleaner than washing dishes by hand. ^^ And when the washing is finished, the door automatically opens and dries. When the door opens, the moisture inside is released, so there is much less moisture buildup, and there is no musty smell. It dries naturally, so it feels hygienic. These days, a dishwasher is a must, but I tried it myself and it is so convenient and nice. Just being freed from the need for dishes feels like a difference in my quality of life. For me, who is pregnant, it is not just a simple appliance, but a valuable item that saves energy and time, so I highly recommend it.
Comments (Original): 둘째까지 임신하다 보니 외식은 점점 힘들어지고, 자연스럽게 집밥을 자주 먹게 되더라구요. 그런데 간단히 먹어도 아이 식기, 간식 접시, 어른들 그릇까지 쓰다보면 설거지거리가 금방 쌓이고, 매끼마다 설거지하는게 쉽지 않더라고요. 그래서 큰맘 먹고 식기세척기를 들이기로 했어요~~‼️그래서 남편이랑 오프라인 매장도 여러 군데 돌아보고 온라인 비교도 많이 했는데, 여기 쿠팡이 가장 저렴하더라구요.아무래도 매장에서 사는게 아니라 설치가 오래 걸리진 않을까, 제대로된 제품이 올까 걱정했는데 설치 날짜 지정도 가능해서 일정 맞추기도 편했고, 기사님도 정말 친절하고 예쁘게 설치해주셔서 기분 좋더라구요~~^^그래서 오자마자 사용해봤는데 역시나 가장 만족스러운 건 대용량이라는거에요. 온 가족 식사 후 나오는 그릇이 생각보다 많은데, 한 번에 다 들어가니 여러 번 나눠 돌릴 필요없어 좋더라구요. 상단 선반은 3단계 높이 조절이 가능해서 큰 냄비나 키 큰 유리컵도 무리 없이 수납되고, 수저 전용 트레이가 따로 있어 뒤엉키지 않게 깔끔하게 세척되구요!!보면 볼수록 공간 활용이 정말 똑똑하게 설계됐다는 느낌이에요♥️세척 코스도 자동, 1시간, 강력, 조용 등 다양해서 상황에 맞게 선택할 수 있는데 기름기 많은 날은 강력 코스로, 평소에는 자동으로 돌리면 알아서 오염도에 맞춰 조절해주니 편하더라고요. 그리고 세척력도 어찌나 좋은지! 손설거지보다 더 깨끗하게 느껴질 정도네요^^그리고 세척이 모두 끝나면 자동으로 문이 열려 건조하는 기능을 가지고 있어요.문이 열리면서 내부 습기를 배출해줘서 물기 맺힘이 훨씬 덜하고, 꿉꿉한 냄새도 없는데다 자연 건조가 되니 위생적인 느낌도 들고요.요즘은 식세기가 필수라는데 직접 써보니 넘 편하고 좋네요.  설거지에서 해방됐다는 것만으로도 삶의 질이 달라진 느낌이에요. 임신 중인 저에게는 단순한 가전이 아니라 체력과 시간을 아껴주는 고마운 아이템이라 정말 추천하고 싶어요 ♥️♥️♥️

So, I took the plunge and decided to get a dishwasher. My husband and I visited several offline stores and compared prices online, and Coupang was the cheapest. I was worried that installing the dishwasher would take longer than buying it in-store and that it wouldn't be properly installed, but we could even choose a specific installation date, which made it easy to schedule. The installer was so friendly and did a great job, which was a real pleasure. I tried it out right away, and as expected, the most satisfying thing about it was its large capacity. After a family meal, there were more dishes than I expected, but it all fit in one place, eliminating the need for multiple dishes. The top shelf is adjustable to three heights, so it can easily accommodate large pots and tall glasses. The dedicated cutlery tray keeps cutlery neatly washed and organized! The more I look at it, the more I realize how cleverly the space is utilized. There are various washing cycles, such as automatic, 1-hour, strong, and quiet, so you can choose the right one for you. On oily days, I use the strong cycle, and on normal days, I use the automatic cycle, which automatically adjusts to the level of dirt, which is convenient. And the cleaning power is amazing! It feels cleaner than washing dishes by hand. ^^ And when the washing is finished, the door automatically opens and dries. When the door opens, the moisture inside is released, so there is much less moisture buildup, and there is no musty smell. It dries naturally, so it feels hygienic. These days, a dishwasher is a must, but I tried it myself and it is so convenient and nice. Just being freed from the need for dishes feels like a difference in my quality of life. For me, who is pregnant, it is not just a simple appliance, but a valuable item that saves energy and time, so I highly recommend it.

Comments (English): As I was pregnant with my second child, eating out became increasingly difficult, and I naturally started eating home-cooked meals more often. However, even for simple meals, using the kids' plates, snack plates, and even the adults' dishes quickly piled up, and washing up after every meal was a challenge. So, I took the plunge and decided to get a dishwasher. My husband and I visited several offline stores and compared prices online, and Coupang was the cheapest. I was worried that installing the dishwasher would take longer than buying it in-store and that it wouldn't be properly installed, but we could even choose a specific installation date, which made it easy to schedule. The installer was so friendly and did a great job, which was a real pleasure. I tried it out right away, and as expected, the most satisfying thing about it was its large capacity. After a family meal, there were more dishes than I expected, but it all fit in one place, eliminating the need for multiple dishes. The top shelf is adjustable to three heights, so it can easily accommodate large pots and tall glasses. The dedicated cutlery tray keeps cutlery neatly washed and organized! The more I look at it, the more I realize how cleverly the space is utilized. There are various washing cycles, such as automatic, 1-hour, strong, and quiet, so you can choose the right one for you. On oily days, I use the strong cycle, and on normal days, I use the automatic cycle, which automatically adjusts to the level of dirt, which is convenient. And the cleaning power is amazing! It feels cleaner than washing dishes by hand. ^^ And when the washing is finished, the door automatically opens and dries. When the door opens, the moisture inside is released, so there is much less moisture buildup, and there is no musty smell. It dries naturally, so it feels hygienic. These days, a dishwasher is a must, but I tried it myself and it is so convenient and nice. Just being freed from the need for dishes feels like a difference in my quality of life. For me, who is pregnant, it is not just a simple appliance, but a valuable item that saves energy and time, so I highly recommend it.

We recently replaced our old Bosch 100 Series Dishwasher, which had been installed around 2009 and performed exceptionally well for years. Based on that experience, we felt confident purchasing another 100 Series. While there are still some strong positives, there are also a few design changes that feel like a step backward. The most noticeable change is the rack configuration. The previous layout was far more intuitive and flexible. In the current model, fitting standard dinner plates and bowls is more challenging, and the spacing does not seem as practical. The cutlery holder also occupies close to a quarter of the bottom rack, which significantly reduces usable space. The addition of the third rack is a nice feature, particularly for larger utensils, but it does not fully offset the reduced flexibility in the main rack. Drying performance is another area where this model falls short compared to our older unit. Even when using the Extra Dry setting, dishes often come out slightly damp. It is not a dealbreaker, but it is noticeably less effective than our previous 100 Series. I also preferred having a physical delay timer option on the dishwasher itself. Now, you need to download the app to access that function, which feels unnecessary for a feature that used to be readily available on the control panel. Pros: - Clean, modern aesthetic - Fingerprint resistant stainless steel - Very quiet operation - Easy to operate - Third rack is useful for larger kitchen utensils Cons: - Less practical rack configuration compared to older model (Plates and bowls are harder to fit) - Cutlery holder takes up significant bottom rack space - Dishes are not as dry, even on Extra Dry setting - Delay timer requires app instead of built-in control

We recently replaced our old Bosch 100 Series Dishwasher, which had been installed around 2009 and performed exceptionally well for years. Based on that experience, we felt confident purchasing another 100 Series. While there are still some strong positives, there are also a few design changes that feel like a step backward. The most noticeable change is the rack configuration. The previous layout was far more intuitive and flexible. In the current model, fitting standard dinner plates and bowls is more challenging, and the spacing does not seem as practical. The cutlery holder also occupies close to a quarter of the bottom rack, which significantly reduces usable space. The addition of the third rack is a nice feature, particularly for larger utensils, but it does not fully offset the reduced flexibility in the main rack. Drying performance is another area where this model falls short compared to our older unit. Even when using the Extra Dry setting, dishes often come out slightly damp. It is not a dealbreaker, but it is noticeably less effective than our previous 100 Series. I also preferred having a physical delay timer option on the dishwasher itself. Now, you need to download the app to access that function, which feels unnecessary for a feature that used to be readily available on the control panel. Sentence (English): The product was delivered on the requested date.
Comments (English): The product was delivered on the requested date. I am satisfied because it cleans thoroughly without leaving any gaps. The product's design is stylish, so it matches my kitchen decor well. I tried this after using products from other brands, and it definitely cleans better. Once I pack them more carefully, the chopsticks don't slip out in standard mode. I haven't used the water jet in turbo mode, so I'm not sure about that. Sentence (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher. I held off on buying one for a while, thinking I'd just wash a few dishes by hand, but I finally bought one with my own money. The bottom line is, I wonder why I didn't buy one. My old-fashionedness has been a pain in the ass. Especially if you have kids, buy one now! The time-saving benefits are incredible. 1. Cleaning power. I heard it varies depending on the detergent, but it leaves dishes shinier and cleaner than when I do it by hand. I regret not buying one sooner. 2. Simple operation, with only the essential features. This product's greatest strengths. It's affordable, intuitive, and has only the most basic functions, making it a great choice for dishwasher beginners. 3. Automatic door opening. After washing, the door automatically opens to dry the dishwasher thoroughly. It's a really useful feature, as long as you keep your kids informed. (My kids are still quite quirky, so I've been training them for quite some time.) 4. Cost-effective. The best part about this product is that it's affordable, with only the basic functions, so you can use it without any worries. I thought all dishwashers cost 200. For those who are new to dishwashing, move frequently, or plan to move within 2-3 years, this one will be really useful and worth keeping. 5. Modern design and color. The design is also very clean. The color is a sophisticated white beige that is popular in home appliances these days. Add a spoonful of beige to the white. I want to use it more neatly, so I peel off the sticker. The sticker comes off really well. This is a very well-made item that I bought with my own money. I love the rocket delivery that came at the perfect time for the holidays.

Comments (English): [ Auntie, I finally got to meet you... ] || ---------------- || I recently moved, and when I tried to air-dry all my dishes on the dish drying rack above my kitchen counter, it was a total mess (-'c). A friend who came over asked why I didn't have a dishwasher and said it would be so much more convenient, so I decided to install one. - (^')b. Pros: Clean design & built-in installation. The sleek, recessed design blends perfectly with my kitchen interior, making the space look much more organized with the built-in installation! The color scheme matches my kitchen tile countertop perfectly, so I'm really happy with it. Ample capacity & great for a family. It's large enough for 12 people, so I can wash all my dishes, plates, pots, and other dishes at once! So far, I haven't felt it's enough for a three-person household, including a baby. Quiet operation. I personally don't find the noise during the wash cycle to be too bothersome; it's like white noise from everyday life. There's also a quiet mode, so you can customize it to your preference. I'm satisfied with the cleaning performance. The basic cleaning performance is stable, so I'm satisfied with the fact that it handles most of the dishes after a meal. So far, there has never been a case where the grease wasn't washed off completely (. .). Disappointing points. Perfect drying is difficult. Sometimes, even after the cycle is over, it doesn't dry completely. In this case, you have no choice but to let it dry naturally a little longer (o'). Drying alone can't be used. It's a bit disappointing that you can't use drying alone and have to run the entire cycle unconditionally (). . Overall. I'm very satisfied because it reduces the time spent washing dishes every day and creates a clean kitchen environment. If you're considering a built-in dishwasher, I highly recommend it (). Sentence (English): We live in a two-person household, so we've always lived without a dishwasher.

The one-hour mode eliminates the pressure of time, so I'll continue to use it.
Comments (Original): 2인가구라서 식기세척기 없이 살아왔는데, 집에서 음식을 자주하다보니 식사 후에 설거지가 부담스러웠던 적이 많았습니다. 주방이 좁은 편이라 기존 식세기 자리를 선반으로 사용했었는데, 이번에 집정리하면서 공간을 확보하고 식세기를 구입했어요. 설치 전에 최소 설치공간이 나오는지 여러 번 확인했고 다행히 싱크대 리폼없이 설치했습니다. 14인용으로 구매해서 2인 점심 + 저녁 식기까지 충분히 커버되는데 아직 배치하는 것에 익숙치않아 다른 분들 후기보면서 연구 중입니다. 세제는 설치기사님이 추천해주신 올인원으로 사용 중인데 따로 린스없이도 물때나 자국없이 깨끗하게 잘 말라있습니다. 스팀에 살균기능도 사용해보니 손으로 닦는 것보다 더 깔끔하게 관리가 되어서 만족하구요. 1시간 모드로 하니 시간압박도 없어서 앞으로도 잘 사용할 것 같습니다.

Cons: If you need to use it right after washing, a hot air dryer model might be more convenient. Those who prefer a tray-style dishwasher with separate compartments might find this disappointing. Sentence (English): GE Profile 18" dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Awful features ] || ---------------- || GE Profile 18" dishwasher. I do not like this dishwasher except for the fact that it cleans the dishes well. The things I dislike the most are the racks, the silverware caddy and the fact that it does not have sound to know when the load is finished. It's very difficult to see which light is for what, so that doesn't help. The racks are awful for trying to maximize the number of dishes you can put in them. Way too many prongs for plates, so bowls or other odd sized dishes do not fit well. The silverware caddy has the top piece with the openings for the silverware but to put in bigger or shorter utensils, you are expected to remove the top piece and put them in, then replace the top piece. It's ridiculous. The 18" GE Profile dishwasher I bought in 2010 was wonderful. the racks and the silverware caddy were perfect. I could load so many dishes in the racks, and the top piece of the silverware caddy had a separate piece on each side, so I could put silverware on one side and tall or wide utensils in the other side. Overall, I really hate this dishwasher and of course was unable to return it because I used it two times to see if I could get past the issues I have with it.

Sentence (English): There aren't many panel-ready dishwashers, in any size, and this was pretty much our only choice.
Comments (English): [ Lacks some features I'd expect ] || ---------------- || There aren't many panel-ready dishwashers, in any size, and this was pretty much our only choice. It's OK. There are no particular eco features to save energy. It doesn't allow you to skip the drying cycle--"express wash" is the only setting that doesn't waste electricity drying, and that's not suitable for every load. There's no cycle that's a middle ground between fast and interminably long. The door is difficult to prop open for air circulation and there's no latch or anything that I can discern to hold it open. The utensil basket and top tray is flimsy, but I do like the top tray for lightweight plastic lids and such. The bottle/vase prop is also neat, though the bottle didn't come clean so I can't say it works. It's noisier than my last dishwasher that was 20 years old. So no, I don't really like it much, but I'm stuck with it.

Sentence (English): As soon as it came out of the box, we knew it was different.
Comments (English): [ Our First new Dishwasher in over 20 years. ] || ---------------- || As soon as it came out of the box, we knew it was different. It matched all of the other newer Samsung appliances in the kitchen, but it was different – no matter how much we touched the front…NO FINGERPRINTS… all the other appliances with a similar front looked old and covered in fingerprints. Not the Dishwasher. The inside of the dishwasher looked newer and modern…the upper area had a water spinner underneath…WOW…2 sources of water to help wash all of the items in the dishwasher; above and below the shelves. Loaded dishes and silverware. Put in a Soap pod, fill the RINSE container. Then we had to figure out the control panel…POWER on – select CYCLES, OPTIONS, Delay, START; CLOSE the DOOR, and it begins. NO dials, no buttons, a clean touch panel on the top of the door. NO SOUND? We kept checking to hear the water and the beginning of the wash cycle. Had to put our ears up close to the door. Ran a complete wash. WOW, it was quiet, we did not know it was running! We had to check the LED lights to know that they were still running. When it was finished, I had to check to see that some LED lights had turned off. Opened the door and everything was Spotless, clean. Easy to lift out the Silverware basket and remove everything from it. Each of the plates, cups, and other items in the dishwasher was spotless and CLEAN>. The overall wash-and-dry process was silent, just a very low hum. We only ran the complete wash, which took about 1.5 hours. There were additional options and settings for shorter washes, delayed washing, and other options related to the wash and rinse process. Overall, the first wash was effortless to set up and get started. The process was also extensive, and everything came out spotless. The front door was and continues to be spotless – no fingerprints. Overall, this is an outstanding new appliance and fits with all of our other Samsung Appliances. The only request would be to be able to add it to my SMARTHINGS app – to know when the wash is over when we are not in the Kitchen and provide information about what stage the wash and rinse process is in, estimated time of completion, and actual completion!

Sentence (English): We got the LG 24 inch flush mount smart dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ So many features! ] || ---------------- || We got the LG 24 inch flush mount smart dishwasher. We got the printproof stainless steel model with a handle. I love that all the controls are on the top so no accidental pushing them. Our previous one did not have the handle so I really like that I can hang a towel on this one. Much more convenient for me right next to the sink instead of behind me on the stove. This comes with an adjustable 2nd rack and a 3rd rack as well. I was a bit worried about the third rack as many of our things are tall but figured I could maybe lower the second rack a little to accommodate things. I did manage for the most part to make things fit. After using it a few times I realized the third rack actually partially slides over so this completely solved the issue. Even though I wash my dishes before putting them in the dishwasher when I realized there was no direct sprayer for that 3rd rack it made me a bit concerned about how clean things would be since the water would have to go around the stuff on 2nd rack to get up there. So far it seems to work well and the stuff looks like it gets plenty of flow up there. The 1 hour wash cycle is a feature I frequently use. This dishwasher is set to open the door after the cycle to aid in drying dishes, so it runs for 50 minutes then opens the door. If like me you are worried about that moisture on your cabinet/counters you can override it in the app but that does extend the cycle to basically 90 minutes. The app is very easy to use and is where many of the adjustments are done. It is nice that you can adjust the amount of rinse aid that is used and it monitors the level so no more trying to remember to refill before you run out! Before we got it I thought the lights inside were silly but now that I have it wow I didn't realize how nice it would be to have that. I also really like the bottle wash section of it as during the summer especially we use a lot of water bottles so now it won't be such a task to wash them. You can even change the tone for when the cycle is complete including holiday tones! The app shows how much time is remaining, how many cycles have been run, allows you to control the dishwasher including remote start or pause. Which if you do have to open the washer after starting it for any reason I would suggest pausing the cycle through the app because there is so much power behind the water spray you might get wet. While I haven't had occasion to use all the cycles what I have used seems to work very well. It does seem to hold a bit less dishes than my old one so I definitely run it daily. The only thing that worries me is that racks feel a bit light compared to my old one and I worry about putting much weight on them. This may not be an issue for others though as I have a lot of heavy dishes due to baking etc. Overall I think this is a great unit and look forward to years of use hopefully!

What a joke.

Lot of plastic and nylon flimsy piping tho, time will tell how long Cons - Installation was not terrible , but not perfect - #1 plastic leveling rotating feet are very hard to adjust with screwdriver , after few turns all slots for screwdriver are almost gone. Plastic is very soft there. Tried to use a wrench on nut - but it is also made out of soft plastic and there it no space to turn 20mm wrech there. So it is kind of 1 time install and you will loose all of adjustability. Cheap cheap design. #2 Metal brackets to attach the dishwasher to sides after you fold them as instructed in manual , have same legnth as rubber seal width. As result - seal does not hide them - they are visible on each side. Also there are not attched to body of dishwasher ( just bent in slots ) , they just hang in slots very loosly - it does not add any strength to installation - you can easly move dishwasher from left to right. I was quite surprised to see it in designed by German engineers appliance . Very cheap and technically wrong design. Also when you sliding in dishwasher they will scrape your cabinet be aware ! protect your cabinet by scraping this cheaply designed appliance. #3 Front door - Face of appliance ! is very thin and vobbly. I can poke a dent with one finger - check video attached. ( apperantly this site does not allow me to upload video ) #4 "Crystal dry" function does not dry properly - I still have puddles of water on my cups on second shelf. Conclusion - designed to save few $$ here and there, lot of plastic in construction, front door is very thin and vobbly , overall appliance probably will no last long. Guys, take out expensive WIFI module which is not going to be used by 99% of your customers, and add metal feet and thicker SS front door, redisign installation bracketery ( check other vendors designs if you do not know how to do it ) so your dishwasher will be secured in cabinet correctly .

Sentence (English): Many people around me use dishwashers, but I never bought one because I thought it would be a hassle to load them all the way through the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ My first dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Many people around me use dishwashers, but I never bought one because I thought it would be a hassle to load them all the way through the dishwasher. But recently, I've been doing dishes late into the night, and I've been spending a lot of time in the kitchen, so I decided to buy one. I knew the 14-seater model would hold more dishes, have a three-tier shelf, and have more features, but I was a bit skeptical about dishwashers, so I bought the basic 12-seater. The price was good because there were a lot of sales, and I even got a credit card discount, so I got it for a good price. In my case, all I had to do was cut the channel, so I paid an additional 30,000 won for installation. From the day it was installed, I intentionally skipped washing the dishes and let them pile up. That evening, I tried it out, and wow, why did I wait so long to buy this? It's a whole new world. It's not all good, but at this price, I'm satisfied just by not having to constantly stand in the kitchen to wash dishes. The only inconvenience is having to bend over to load the dishes. But I figured everyone else would do it this way, so I'll stick with it. And there is a separate cutlery washing container, which is convenient, but it takes up a lot of space, so it has its pros and cons. I washed the stainless steel spatula roughly and washed it with a scrubber, but some of it didn't come off, maybe because it was too hardened. ^^;. Nevertheless, I am very satisfied overall, and it is nice that I can reduce the time I spend in the kitchen and be freed from the dishwashing hell. On days when I use oily dishes, I put in one tablet of Prosch detergent, but it works well even with half a tablet. If you are thinking about it, buy it quickly! It would be great if you buy it when the price is good. I bought the basic model on purpose, but I think I made a good decision buying the basic product for 12 people.

Comments (English): [ My first dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Many people around me use dishwashers, but I never bought one because I thought it would be a hassle to load them all the way through the dishwasher. But recently, I've been doing dishes late into the night, and I've been spending a lot of time in the kitchen, so I decided to buy one. I knew the 14-seater model would hold more dishes, have a three-tier shelf, and have more features, but I was a bit skeptical about dishwashers, so I bought the basic 12-seater. The price was good because there were a lot of sales, and I even got a credit card discount, so I got it for a good price. In my case, all I had to do was cut the channel, so I paid an additional 30,000 won for installation. From the day it was installed, I intentionally skipped washing the dishes and let them pile up. That evening, I tried it out, and wow, why did I wait so long to buy this? It's a whole new world. It's not all good, but at this price, I'm satisfied just by not having to constantly stand in the kitchen to wash dishes. The only inconvenience is having to bend over to load the dishes. But I figured everyone else would do it this way, so I'll stick with it. And there is a separate cutlery washing container, which is convenient, but it takes up a lot of space, so it has its pros and cons. I washed the stainless steel spatula roughly and washed it with a scrubber, but some of it didn't come off, maybe because it was too hardened. ^^;. Nevertheless, I am very satisfied overall, and it is nice that I can reduce the time I spend in the kitchen and be freed from the dishwashing hell. On days when I use oily dishes, I put in one tablet of Prosch detergent, but it works well even with half a tablet. If you are thinking about it, buy it quickly! It would be great if you buy it when the price is good. I bought the basic model on purpose, but I think I made a good decision buying the basic product for 12 people.

I knew the 14-seater model would hold more dishes, have a three-tier shelf, and have more features, but I was a bit skeptical about dishwashers, so I bought the basic 12-seater. The price was good because there were a lot of sales, and I even got a credit card discount, so I got it for a good price. In my case, all I had to do was cut the channel, so I paid an additional 30,000 won for installation. From the day it was installed, I intentionally skipped washing the dishes and let them pile up. That evening, I tried it out, and wow, why did I wait so long to buy this? It's a whole new world. It's not all good, but at this price, I'm satisfied just by not having to constantly stand in the kitchen to wash dishes. The only inconvenience is having to bend over to load the dishes. But I figured everyone else would do it this way, so I'll stick with it. And there is a separate cutlery washing container, which is convenient, but it takes up a lot of space, so it has its pros and cons. I washed the stainless steel spatula roughly and washed it with a scrubber, but some of it didn't come off, maybe because it was too hardened. ^^;. Nevertheless, I am very satisfied overall, and it is nice that I can reduce the time I spend in the kitchen and be freed from the dishwashing hell. On days when I use oily dishes, I put in one tablet of Prosch detergent, but it works well even with half a tablet. If you are thinking about it, buy it quickly! It would be great if you buy it when the price is good. I bought the basic model on purpose, but I think I made a good decision buying the basic product for 12 people.

Sentence (English): With the workload of managing household chores while working, I finally took the plunge and bought a dishwasher.
Comments (English): With the workload of managing household chores while working, I finally took the plunge and bought a dishwasher. Among them, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher (Grade 1, True Steam) without hesitation, thanks to its design and performance. After using it for a few months, I'll share my honest thoughts. *Drying power: Thanks to the hot air and automatic door opening, even the plastics are almost fluffy. The drying performance was better than expected. Reviews of actual users have mentioned a significant reduction in water stains with the hot air drying and automatic door opening, and I can really feel it. Even plastics dry well without water pooling when placed upside down. *Noise level: It's comfortable even when running at night. Even if you come home late after working late, you can run it with peace of mind. User reviews say it's quiet enough to watch TV with the living room door closed. Even by my standards, it's quite quiet. Overall: I highly recommend it for dual-income families with children. It delivers the perfect balance of cleaning power, drying power, and water stain control. Saves 30-40 minutes of dishwashing time every day. No worries about electricity bills. Even the design is impressive. This product truly exemplifies what a "quality-of-life appliance" is. I highly recommend it, especially to those who find hand-washing stressful, live in areas with high water stains, or are concerned about their kitchen interior.

Sentence (English): So, I finally decided to switch to a Samsung Bespoke AI Hot Air Dishwasher.
Comments (English): I had been using a 12-seater dishwasher for a long time, but because it didn't have a hot air drying function, I had to always leave the door open and let it air dry. Water stains have been reduced, and the stress of water droplets on cups and plastic containers has disappeared. It also feels much more hygienic. Now, I can wash dishes almost all at once after a meal, which is much more efficient. The basket structure is well-designed, making it easy to organize dishes, and the intuitive layout made it easy to get used to. The cleaning power also exceeded my expectations. Even greasy and seasoned dishes are cleaned thoroughly, and it's surprisingly quiet, so I can even use it at night without any worries. Thanks to the AI function, it feels like the washing process is tailored to the situation, so I trust it. The design is, as expected from a Bespoke brand, clean and uncluttered, without any distractions, which doesn't detract from the kitchen's overall aesthetic. The built-in design also keeps the space looking organized. Since this is an appliance I use every day, design satisfaction was important, and it passed the test. Overall, this appliance goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me, and it significantly improves my convenience. Especially for those like me who moved from a model without a hot air dryer, the difference will be dramatic. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking to reduce the stress of dishwashing. Since I bought it with my own money, I can honestly say I'm extremely satisfied. Pros: The hot air dryer is incredibly convenient. It also feels like the burden of pre-washing has been reduced. It's relatively quiet, so it's not a major issue even when running at night, making it easy to adapt to my lifestyle. Having used a 12-person model, I've noticed a significant difference in storage capacity and convenience. It truly meets my own standards!

Overall, this appliance goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me, and it significantly improves my convenience. Especially for those like me who moved from a model without a hot air dryer, the difference will be dramatic. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking to reduce the stress of dishwashing. Overall, this appliance goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me, and it significantly improves my convenience. Comments (English): [ Defective product - terrible customer service ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher in June 2025 and within 6 months, it stopped working. I called back Feb 3 to find out why it was not rescheduled and they apologized and said they would send someone on Feb 6 and that I would get a 4 hr window the day before and a call ahead the day of. So I called and they told me that the appointment was not scheduled, but they could schedule the service for the 10th. And then they told me that their guys could only check to see if the appliance was installed correctly, not actually repair the error code and that I would need to call the manufacturer. That would have been helpful information to learn 17 days ago - not after being without a working dishwasher for weeks. Home Depot customer service offered nothing but "you have to understand, after 48 hrs from install, you have to call the manufacturer". Why couldn't they have told me that on Jan 23? After several phone calls, each at least 30 minutes to an hour long, and weeks without a working dishwasher, why couldn't they have told me that on day 1 so that I could be working towards a resolution rather than a wild goose chase.

Sentence (English): When our dishwasher of 20+ years started to fail, I did quite a bit of research before deciding on the Bosch 800 Series dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Quiet Dishwasher and Good Install Experience ] || ---------------- || When our dishwasher of 20+ years started to fail, I did quite a bit of research before deciding on the Bosch 800 Series dishwasher. Besides being among the highest ranked dishwasher in Consumer Reports, I also saw many positive reviews on the dishwasher. Costco had the best price (and was on sale) and offered install and hall away service. We have used Costco in the past and it has worked very well for other appliances and furniture. The Bosch 800 is so quiet you can hardly tell it is on and has worked well for us in the first month.Many of the negative reviews on the Costco site are around installation. Our installation went very smoothly because I read those reviews in advance and made sure the space was ready for the installation. This meant that we did hire a handyman to pull the old unit, install a new electrical socket (the old unit was directly wired) and that the hole to the sink area was enlarged. (The Bosch 800 has a larger head on the hose so needs a larger hole.) While this was an extra expense, it was worth it for a seamless installation. If we had not done the prep work, it would have meant the installation would have had to be rescheduled as the Costco installers are often not qualified to do electrical work. You also do not want ugly holes in your cabinetry so having a professional complete it made it look much cleaner. Miss the rack design of my old Kitchen Aid dishwasher with evenly spaced out, upright tines, allowing me to choose how I load, and also maximize the number of dishes which can be washed at once. There should be options to choose a differently designed lower rack when purchasing. Wish I had read the many independant posts about this online before purchasing this brand and model, as it seems to be a concern with many others too. Will not be recommending to the many others I know who use dishwashers.

I don't say this lightly, you LITERALLY cannot hear it run. At all. Nada. If not for the cool light it projects on the floor showing time to completion you would not know it was running. Like, it even removed coffee stains from the inside of our coffee mugs that never came out before. The difference is amazing and by the way, our previous unit was "high end" brand. The final bonus is the software. I know it sounds frivolous, but it's cool to get a message on my phone telling me the dishwasher is done and ready to be emptied. LG, you should come pick this lemon up and explain why your dishwashers don't work. Otherwise, just run—don't walk—away from this nightmare.
